population: all dates in exact six previously pinned MNQ producer summaries, plus existing approved resolver session declarations
payload_allowed: metadata summaries: date label, declared tick count, first/last UTC; no raw ticks, trade prices, event outcome exports or holdout prices
predeclared_checks: date labels strictly later than official U.S. quarterly expiry date
all flagged counts retained and reconciled
whether flagged date labels are approved resolver selections
timestamps converted independently to America/Chicago for context, not timezone certification
generic third-Friday date vs official exceptions
compare declared rolls to customary CME roll dates without requiring equality
limitations: same-day termination time is not assessed
first/last summary endpoints do not locate every trade or prove intraday order
calendar trade label is a producer declaration not verified exchange identity
current CME page is not historical available-at evidence
date conflict cannot identify late reporting, corrections, mislabelling or exporter artefacts
no threshold or exclusion chosen from outcomes

comparison_plan.grain: flagged source date records and roll declarations
comparison_plan.reason: categorical identity/date QA, not an effect estimate or time-series chart
